newsitem.title: USA: Orthologic forecasts Q4 range. [CORRECTED 00:16 GMT 20/12]
newsitem.headline: Orthologic forecasts Q4 range. [CORRECTED 00:16 GMT 20/12]

text.p: OrthoLogic Corp said it expects net income for the fourth quarter to be in a range from a profit of $0.01 per share to a loss of $0.04 loss per share.
In the year ago quarter, the company reported a profit of $0.02 per share. (Company corrects year ago quarter profit from $0.01 per share.)
It said it expects sales of $15.8 million to $16.8 million for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996. Orthologic reported sales of $5.0 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The quarter includes three months of operating results of Sutter Corp, which was acquired August 30. The company expects to report fourth quarter results on January 30, 1996.
Orthologic attributes the fourth quarter results primarily to the continuing impact of the recent conversion from an independent dealer sales network to a direct salesforce and associated costs.

"Our projected fourth quarter results reflect the fact that it is likely to take longer than we expected to get all territories to the desired level of productivity," said George Oram, president and chief operating officer.
